_doc: CI improvement versions for the CI impact tab (#obs/impact). v0 = the live window of 'baseline_days' days before the FIRST merge of v1's start_prs (fetched again on every refresh, never frozen). Each version starts burn_in_hours (default 24) after the LATEST merge of its 'start_prs' (when all its PR-flow changes are live) and ends where the next version starts (the newest one: now). 'prs' are shown on the page; 'weekly_from' = the PR whose merge starts the weekly-build count of that version. To add v2: append {id, title, prs, start_prs}, then run collect_ci_impact.py.
